description: This file defines the 'AdvertiserFragment' class, an Android Fragment that manages Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) advertising. It provides UI controls to start and stop advertising, displays error messages, and handles broadcast receiver for advertising failure notifications.

classes.name: AdvertiserFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that provides UI to start and stop BLE advertising, handle advertising errors, and manage the broadcast receiver for advertising failure notifications.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the broadcast receiver to handle advertising failure callbacks.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment layout and initializes the UI switch for advertising control.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Checks current advertising state and registers broadcast receiver for advertising failures.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Unregisters the broadcast receiver to prevent memory leaks.

methods.name: getServiceIntent
methods.description: Creates an intent targeting the AdvertiserService class.

methods.name: onClick
methods.description: Handles toggle switch clicks to start or stop BLE advertising.

methods.name: startAdvertising
methods.description: Starts the AdvertiserService to begin BLE advertising.

methods.name: stopAdvertising
methods.description: Stops the AdvertiserService to terminate BLE advertising and updates UI switch.
